question.para: How can I report a bug?

answer.para: Accumulate as much as possible information (&oMarinkaRodeo; version, openMarinkaRodeo -V output, your OS (uname -a), &oMarinkaRodeo; logs, network dumps, core dump files, configuration file) and send a mail to &oMarinkaRodeodevlink;
Also you may try OpenMarinkaRodeo's bug report web page: https://openMarinkaRodeo.org/pmwiki.php?n=Development.Tracker

question.para: How can I debug ssl/tls problems?

answer.para: Increase the log level in openMarinkaRodeo.cfg (log_level=4) and watch the log statements in syslog.
Install the ssldump utility and start it. This will give you a trace of the ssl/tls connections.

question.para: What is the difference between the TLS directory and the TLSOPS module directory?

answer.para: The code in the TLS directory implements the TLS transport layer. The TLSOPS module implements TLS related functions which can be used in the routing script.
